descriptions.text: Drawing: A well-shaded, curved piece of metal with little electric bolts coming off it. Associated Spell: Big-Ass Magnet. Casts at level 14.

beats.headline: A page from Mees Koning
beats.text: An entry in Donut's A Banquet Fit for a Princess comes from Mees Koning 2, half-orc, Boring Ol' Mage, final level 63. He always felt invisible; a backfired spell left him with two player-killer skulls and nobody at all. Before the battle at the southern border in Faction Wars, Donut stopped, said she liked his fangs, waited out his stutter and told him we all have scars. He was inside the ball when she cast her Atrocity. He used to draw anime characters, and his drawing is a well-shaded curved piece of metal with little electric bolts coming off it: Big-Ass Magnet.

beats.headline: The backup plan
beats.text: In the fifth heat, Prepotente's plan is for Bianca, his hellspawn familiar, to grab Corky out of the back seat of the Lady Dominators' car, once its shield is down. If that does not work, there is a backup plan, which Carl came up with about ten minutes earlier and which is a little more iffy. It involves the Big-Ass Magnet spell Donut has just eaten from her Feast book.

beats.headline: Every screw in the factory
beats.text: Corcunda, one man again, will go out to meet Grull, and Dong climbs onto his back with his lance pointed out the open back of the truck. Wait, says Donut: it has to be cast on an object, it activates at once and grows for about fifteen seconds, so be far away. It is the spell meant for Genesis and Rapture's car. She casts it on the lance as they jump. Every screw within two hundred metres rockets toward the charging pair, through the slag elementals, which stagger and melt into puddles of molten steel. The lance meets the god of war, and Grull vanishes back to the twelfth floor.
